responsibility: This header declares global interfaces related to GCC compilation flags and flag-derived state. It exposes debug-format query helpers, fast-math tests, final-insn dump state, and the switchable target_flag_state object that stores parsed code-alignment options for loops, jumps, labels, and functions. It is the lightweight declaration layer that lets the rest of the compiler query flag semantics and target-adjustable alignment option state without pulling in option parser implementation details.
